assets.creator: Orestis Oikonomou
assets.source: Original vector artwork and deterministic scalar evaluation authored for this repository
assets.changes: AI-assisted original SVG plates: wave-sources.svg, wave-propagation.svg and wave-interference.svg. Fixed sources A = (−2.25, 0), B = (+2.25, 0); domain x ∈ [−7, 7], y ∈ [−3.5, 3.5]; k = 2π / 2.4. Final color cells and level contours directly evaluate cos(k rA) + cos(k rB). This is an illustrative static scalar construction, not a physical solver or publication claim. No third-party figures, fonts, scripts, foreign objects, or remote image references are distributed.
